name: Vivid Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: VividBusiness

sections.description:
What does this plugin do for you
Features:
* Accept debit and credit card payments at good rates
* Support for payments with Apple Pay and Google Pay
* Refund payments directly from your Vivid Business
Great pricing:
* Pocket more of what you earn with low, competitive pricing for businesses of all sizes
* Get started with processing rates of 0.69% + €0.25 for local, consumer cards, and 2.49% + €0.25 for all other cards
Settlement and security:
* Get your earnings deposited directly to your Vivid Merchant account with instant payout option
* Reduce your risk of fraud by relying on Vivid’s array of fraud monitoring tools that can flag early signs
* Our payments product is both encrypted and PCI DSS certified

What your customers will like

Keeping your customers happy is huge, and offering them the simplest and smoothest customer payment experience helps you do just that. With our payment gateway, customers can:
* Pay in the currency of their choice
* Experience streamlined checkout
* Enjoy peace of mind with our secure payment processing

External services

This plugin connects to Vivid Money’s API to process payments through their service. It is required to enable transactions between the customer and the merchant using the Vivid Money platform.

When a customer initiates a payment via Vivid Money, the plugin sends the following data to the Vivid Money API:
– Transaction details (amount, currency, order ID)
– Customer information (name, email, billing address)
– Merchant account credentials (API key or token, securely stored in plugin settings)

This data is sent during the checkout process when a customer chooses to pay via Vivid Money.

This service is provided by Vivid Money S.A.:
– Terms of Service: https://vivid.money/en-eu/terms-and-conditions/
– Privacy Policy: https://vivid.money/en-eu/privacy-policy/

Use of this plugin implies acceptance of Vivid Money’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Please ensure you review them before activating the plugin.
sections.installation:
To use the plugin you need to have a Vivid Business Account and complete card payments onboarding.

If you don’t have a Vivid Business account:
* Sign up for a Business account
* Enable card Payments in “Get Paid” section
* Indicate a category that most closely defines your activities
* Provide the domain of your [WooCommerce] website when asked about website of your business

If you already have a Vivid Business account, but you have not completed card payment onboarding:
* Once logged-in into Vivid Business web portal click on Get Paid section
* Click Enable Card Payments and follow the steps to fill in the information of your business
* When prompted, provide the domain of your [WooCommerce] website

That’s it! As soon as you install the Vivid Gateway for WooCommerce plugin you will be ready to start accepting payments. If you want to know more about the advantages of accepting payments via Vivid, you can take a look at our website.
